newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-MARSEILLE MAY BE COURTING FERNANDEZ - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARSEILLE MAY BE COURTING FERNANDEZ - PAPER.

text.p: Athletic Bilbao's French trainer Luis Fernandez could be on his way to Marseille, the daily Le Parisien said on Friday.
It said the former French international met Marseille president Robert Louis-Dreyfus at his Adidas headquarters in Paris on Wednesday.
But Marseille's executive director Jean-Michel Roussier and sporting director Marcel Dib denied the meeting had taken place.
In Marseille, coach Gerard Gili said he knew nothing about a meeting and aimed to see his contract through to the end of next season.
